summary: Study C needs an exit report that compares two strategies on attack win rate without ever counting an unverified battle. trial_report.py gains a --pvp mode next to the SPEC-07 progression report (unchanged):  - Battles are credited through TrialRecord.attribution_at (adoption log   plus windows); battles outside a recorded application have no strategy. - An attack outcome is known only when its journal event verified at tier   outcome-observed with no error, or a battle-history attacker record with   its battle id exists (S03-R5). A history record that contradicts a known   journal outcome makes it unknown. Unknown outcomes are counted (R3). - compare_strategies runs with per_arm_min_sample from sdk.experiments.study   when the plan gives an effect size, else the plan's min_sample; it is   stratified by opponent cohort whenever one was observed, and short   samples give insufficient-evidence with no recommendation (R4). - Defenses come only from battle-history defender records and are reported   in their own section; they never drive the recommendation (R5). - The report carries the game version, per-strategy counts, Wilson   intervals, net trophies, resource cost, the verdict and recommendation,   and limitations including approximate timing for by-hand adoptions (R6).  The battle-history input is a documented, provisional JSON list format until the SPEC-03 listPvPBattles2 parser exists. sdk/reports/pvp.py exposes cohort_label and observed_spend so the report reuses the scorecard's logic. Implemented by the SPEC-08 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (APPROVE), and re-validated by the parent.

proof: make syntax-check, make test, scripts/ci.py lint and git diff --check pass on current main
